method: Restart Convertigo, prepare registered Flow plans, call sample_HelloWorld_flow.GetFeed against the same local RSS fixture, then exercise MCP initialize, tools/list and tools/call with separate contexts.

steps.change: Opt-in Java bridge and JSON-to-XML profile
Reserve project descriptors but compile implementations lazily
Compile direct Rhino blocks during plan preparation and defer Flow composites

conclusion: Project block QNames and descriptors can be indexed independently from implementation compilation. Targeted Rhino preparation preserves GetFeed cold behavior while reducing the 101-block MCP plan preparation by more than 90 percent.
